caption: The drawing features a single object resembling an elephant centered on a plain, beige background. The elephant is depicted in a side view facing to the right, with its entire body visible. The body of the elephant is shaded in various tones of gray and black, with darker areas providing contour along the underside, legs, and head, while subtle brownish highlights accent certain parts such as the ears, legs, and body lines. The tusks are long and curved, prominently extending from the face and rendered in a light cream or off-white color. The feet and the tip of the trunk are more darkly colored compared to the rest of the body. No additional objects or background elements are present, and the drawing is composed simply, focusing solely on the stylized, gray-toned elephant with exaggerated tusks. In the bottom right corner, there is a small text that reads "ORISON OGEDA 1937."
title: Toy Elephant
